paragraphs: R' Yosi bar Ilai. See the entry Rav Yosef, son of Rav Ilai.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has אלעאי and the target עילאי, with Yosi and Yosef respectively; these consonantal differences remain visible in the Hebrew. An earlier heading audit had אילעא, and the heading remains provisional. The heading’s abbreviated title remains R'; both target Rav titles are explicit.
